issues.problem: The entry-point error handling is changed before any failing test exercises it, contrary to the confirmed test-first requirement.
issues.evidence: Step 2.1 changes main.ts to catch RunError and print describe(e), but its Red tests call run directly; neither test/run.test.ts nor test/helpers.ts imports or executes main.ts. Entry-point output and exit-code tests arrive only in 6.1. U2 covers the later platform-runner binding, not this interim error-handling logic. Add a testable error-reporting boundary and observe its tests failing before changing main.ts, or explicitly obtain approval for the exact untested interim code under R4.
